comment: The MODE switch is configured the other way round from the one on Switcher: here position 0 is Toggle and position 1 is Gate (Switcher8.cpp:68), though both modules come up in Toggle. There is no fade CV input on this version, and the fade CV lines are commented out at :265-266 and :294-295. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
